content.description: Troubleshooting flowchart for engine stalling issue with multiple decision points and diagnostic steps

steps.text:
CHECK DIAGNOSIS SYSTEM
Check for output of diagnostic code
(See page FI-22)
CHECK FOR VACUUM LEAKS IN AIR INTAKE LINE
bad_actions: 5. EGR system — EGR valve stays open

steps.text:
CHECK FUEL SUPPLY TO INJECTOR
1. Fuel in tank
2. Fuel pressure in fuel line
   (1) Short fuel pump check terminals.
   (2) You can feel fuel pressure at fuel hose.
(See page FI-45)

CHECK IGNITION TIMING
1. Short both terminals of the check connector.
2. Check ignition timing.
   STD: 10° BTDC
       (w/short terminals of the check connector)

CHECK SPARK PLUGS
Max. allowable gap: 1.4 mm (0.055 in.)
Precaution: Never attempt to adjust gap on used platinum tipped spark plug.
— Note —
Check compression pressure if necessary.
(See page EM-6)
no_actions:
2. Compression pressure
   Limit: 9.0 kg/cm² (128 psi, 883 kPa)
         at 250 rpm

steps.text:
CHECK COLD START INJECTOR
(See page FI-48)
bad_actions:
2. Start injector time switch
   (See page FI-71)
